_doc: ElevenLabs prompts for every sound (pipeline/gen_audio.py). name_vN = variants of one sound, picked at random in game. Music is instrumental and made loopable by gen_audio (crossfade of the end into the start).

ui_hover.text: very soft short wooden tick, subtle cute menu hover blip

ui_click.text: soft bubbly pop click, cute game menu button press

ui_back.text: soft descending two-note blip, cute game menu cancel

buy.text: cheerful upgrade purchase sound, soft rising chime with a gentle coin sparkle, cute casual game UI

deny.text: soft muted error boop, short and gentle, cute game UI cannot afford sound

ticket.text: rubber stamp thump on paper followed by a tiny cheerful ding, approval stamp, cute game

fling.text: quick light whoosh of food tossed from a metal ladle, short air swish

catch_v1.text: soft muffled thud of a rice ball landing in a metal lunch box, light tin clink, cute

catch_v2.text: small soft plop of food dropping into a steel bento box compartment, gentle clink

catch_gold.text: sparkly magical twinkle with a bright coin chime, rare golden item collected

bounce.text: comedic springy boing of food bouncing off a full metal lunch box

spill.text: food sloshing and spilling out of a metal lunch box, quick messy splat and clatter

floor.text: soft squishy splat of food falling on a tiled floor, small and cute

deliver.text: metal lunch box set down on a wooden table, solid clack with a little rattle

chomp_v1.text: cute quick chomp and munch, a small mouth eagerly eating rice, cartoon

chomp_v2.text: tiny cartoon nom nom bite, soft and cute eating sound

chomp_v3.text: small eager gulp and munch, cute cartoon eating

token.text: tiny digital coin blip, bright and short, reward counter tick

crit.text: big satisfying cartoon gulp followed by a sparkly ding, bonus reward

veg_reject.text: cartoon pfft spit and a disgusted little raspberry blow, comedic and cute

box_return.text: light whoosh of an empty metal tray sliding through the air

peak_start.text: cartoon rush hour alert: quick brass fanfare with a kitchen bell ringing, hurry up energy

peak_end.text: relieved descending soft chime, things calming down

shift_start.text: cheerful school canteen lunch bell, bright two-tone ding dong, lunch time

shift_full.text: cute satisfied little burp followed by a happy sigh, cartoon, not gross

shift_closed.text: canteen closing time: metal shutter rolling down with a gentle bell

think_start.text: dreamy slow-motion whoosh, time slowing down, soft reverse cymbal into a low hum

think_end.text: time speeding back up, quick rising whoosh

server_busy.text: short digital error buzzer, server busy, comedic retro computer beep

crash.text: comedic computer crash, glitchy power-down sound with little sparks

trial_pass.text: triumphant short festive fanfare with firecrackers and a gong, Chinese New Year celebration, cute game victory jingle

trial_fail.text: comedic sad trombone wah wah wah, cute game failure jingle

version_up.text: magical level up jingle, rising sparkles and a bright happy chord

result.text: short cozy reward jingle, warm marimba arpeggio ending on a sparkle

fish_squeak_v1.text: cute small happy squeak of a chubby cartoon sea creature, adorable

fish_squeak_v2.text: adorable tiny surprised squeak, cute cartoon creature being poked

pan.text: soft paper rustle, a map being dragged

clang_v1.text: a metal spoon banging on an empty stainless steel basin, one bright clang, cartoon

clang_v2.text: single tinny clank of a spoon hitting a metal bowl rim, cute game sound

clang_v3.text: a quick hollow metallic bong of a spoon on a steel wash basin

helmet.text: an empty metal basin plonked upside down onto someone's head, hollow comedic bonk

hmph.text: a cute small huffy 'hmph' of a sulking cartoon girl, short

crew_hop.text: tiny soft cartoon footstep hop, light and cute

catch_crisp_v1.text: light crispy crunch of a fried chicken drumstick dropping into a metal lunch box, crackly golden batter, short

catch_crisp_v2.text: short crunchy rustle of french fries and fried dough landing in a tin bento box, crisp crackle

catch_slosh_v1.text: small liquid slosh of a cup of soup landing in a metal lunch tray, gentle splash, short

catch_slosh_v2.text: short wet gloop of porridge and a drink cup dropped into a steel bento box, soft splish

catch_saucy_v1.text: wet saucy splat of stir fried vegetables landing in a metal lunch box, juicy, short and soft

catch_saucy_v2.text: short juicy plop of braised pork with sauce dropping into a tin tray compartment

catch_wobble_v1.text: cute jiggly jelly wobble of a pudding landing on a plate, bouncy boing, short

catch_wobble_v2.text: soft springy jello wiggle of a dessert dropping into a lunch box, playful, short

combo_v1.text: bright single service bell ding, cheerful kitchen order up, clean and short

combo_v2.text: small microwave ready ding, crisp cute chime, short

perc_shaker.text: single short shaker hit, dry, one hit only, percussion sample

perc_clap.text: single tight hand clap, dry studio percussion one shot

perc_bongo.text: single high bongo drum hit, dry, one shot percussion sample

perc_block.text: single wooden temple block knock, dry clock tick, one shot

amb_canteen.text: busy school canteen ambience, soft crowd chatter, cutlery and plates clinking, distant kitchen sounds, warm and lively, no music

bgm_title.prompt: Cozy cheerful lofi-pop title theme for a cute anime canteen game, warm electric piano and pizzicato strings, soft brushed drums, glockenspiel melody, inviting and a little silly, 95 bpm, steady groove that loops, instrumental, no vocals

bgm_run.prompt: Upbeat bouncy cartoon lunch-rush music for a cute catching game, marimba and plucky ukulele, snappy snare and handclaps, playful whistled lead, busy school canteen energy, 125 bpm, steady groove that loops, instrumental, no vocals

bgm_tree.prompt: Calm cozy lofi beat for an upgrade menu, warm Rhodes piano, soft vinyl crackle, round bass, content and sleepy after a big meal, 80 bpm, steady groove that loops, instrumental, no vocals

bgm_trial.prompt: Frantic festive Chinese New Year chase music for a cute game, fast erhu and suona lead, guzheng plucks, firecracker percussion and gongs, comedic panic, 150 bpm, steady groove that loops, instrumental, no vocals
